patches.why: TEXT LOST FROM THE DIGITIZATION, PLATE READ 2026-09-21 (archive patrologiaecurs76unkngoog leaf n9). The volume's resumption banner, SEQUITUR / USUARDI MARTYROLOGIUM., stands above MENSIS MAIUS and is absent from the TEI. Restored as a book-title banner, the 8382 precedent. It is also the plate's own statement that 9215 CONTINUES 9198, one work across two tomes.

DIGITIZATION MISREADING, PLATE READ 2026-09-21 (archive patrologiaecurs76unkngoog leaf n9, the opening page of the work: SEQUITUR USUARDI MARTYROLOGIUM / MENSIS MAIUS, signature PATROL. CXXIV at the foot; map leaf = (col + 9)/2, calibrated at n20 = cols 31/32). Kalends of May, the Andeolus entry: the plate sets 'et sic demum ab ense lignato, in crucis modum caput ejus scindi', read on a full-resolution crop of the full-width Usuardus band. Corpus Corporum has 'ligneo'. One word, one site.
